## Research

::: {.timeline}
### Postdoctoral Researcher
[Sep 2022 – present · Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA), Heisenberg group]{.when}

Cell–cell adhesion and embryo geometry in early ascidian (*Phallusia*) development. Funded by an FWF ESPRIT fellowship (2024–2027), after an initial Marie Skłodowska-Curie COFUND fellowship (IST-BRIDGE, 2022–2024).

### PhD in Biology
[2016 – 2021 · University of Münster, Luschnig group]{.when}

Membrane trafficking and cell mechanics during epithelial tube fusion. Supervised four BSc/MSc student research projects (2018–2021).

### MSc in Biochemistry
[2013 – 2015 · University of Lisbon]{.when}

### BSc in Biochemistry
[2010 – 2013 · University of Lisbon]{.when}
:::

## Communication & outreach

::: {.timeline}
### Science Communication I: Sharing Science With a General Audience
[Fall 2026 · UCSC Silicon Valley Extension (in progress)]{.when}

### Public science engagement, VISTA Science & AITHYRA
[2025 – present · ISTA]{.when}

Featured in "Next Gen Scientist", VISTA Science's video interview series on paths into a research career. Co-presented "Meet the Scientist", a public talk and lab tour on embryonic development. Guest researcher for the AITHYRA Life Sciences School 2026, an outreach programme for Ukrainian high-school science students.

### Job shadowing, ISTA Communications Department
[Feb – Mar 2025]{.when}

Shadowed the social media team, science writers and the press-release journalist. Designed and was credited for the [auxin-signalling schematic](../illustration/projects/2025-auxin-signaling-ista-news/index.qmd) in an ISTA news feature.

### Pen pal volunteer, Letters to a Pre-Scientist
[2023 – present]{.when}

Accessible science writing for pre-college students from underserved backgrounds.

### Volunteer illustrator, Stop Finning EU
[2021]{.when}

Flyers and [social media graphics](../illustration/projects/2021-stop-finning-campaign/index.qmd) for an animal-welfare advocacy campaign.
